candidates.statement: Payment authorization calls time out (ReadTimeout, ~2s) from order, causing order /v1/orders 502s and gateway /v1/checkout 502s; payment p95 latency is ~4875ms while inventory/redis calls succeed quickly.
candidates.uncertainty: Payment-side cause of the latency (internal saturation vs. dependency) is not established; payment logs were excluded.

report.explanation: Traces show inventory/redis succeeding while payment POST /v1/authorizations fails with ReadTimeout, propagating 502s up through order to gateway checkout. Payment p95 latency (~4875ms) exceeds the observed ~2s timeout, consistent with downstream latency at payment. Payment-internal root cause remains unconfirmed.
missing_evidence: Payment service logs/traces to identify why /v1/authorizations exceeds the ~2s client timeout
Payment dependency metrics (DB/external) to rule out payment-internal saturation
